steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, 3.0); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const a = F.v(-5.95, 1.75, -10.7); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = Math.atan2(a.y - G.eye.y, Math.hypot(a.x - G.eye.x, a.z - G.eye.z)); window.__m = []; const m0 = G.hud.message.bind(G.hud); G.hud.message = (t, x) => { window.__m.push(t); return m0(t, x); }; return 1; })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K, L = K.lift; const me = F.l(N.controller.pos.x, N.controller.pos.z); return JSON.stringify({ me: [+me.x.toFixed(2), +me.z.toFixed(2)], gy: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2), L: [L.L.x0, L.L.x1, L.L.z0, L.L.z1].map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)), ly: L.y, at: L.at, cur: G.interact.current && G.interact.current.prompt }); })()

(() => { const L = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel').live.K.lift; return JSON.stringify({ msgs: window.__m, riding: L.riding, y: L.y, target: L.target, t: L.t, gy: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2), lvl: G.city.places.level }); })()

(() => { const L = G.city.places.byId.get('hotel').live.K.lift; return JSON.stringify({ msgs: window.__m, riding: L.riding, y: L.y, at: L.at, gy: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2), lvl: G.city.places.level, time: G.time }); })()

(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0.2, 3.0); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()
(() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const p = F.w(0.85, -1.2); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(-Math.PI / 2), -0.05, K.roofY); return 1; })()

(() => { const P = G.city.places, s = P.byId.get('stairs1'), K = s.live.K; const D = K.doors.find((d) => d.name === 'roof'); return JSON.stringify({ inside: P.inside && P.inside.id, lvl: P.level, gy: +N.controller.groundY.toFixed(2), N: K.N, dl: D.lvl, prompt: G.hud.promptShown, cur: G.interact.current && G.interact.current.prompt }); })()

(() => { const P = G.city.places, s = P.byId.get('stairs1'), K = s.live.K, F = s.frame; const D = K.doors.find((d) => d.name === 'roof'); const p = F.w(1.75, -1.25); return JSON.stringify({ shut: D.shut, angle: D.angle, lvl: P.level, near: G.stage.colliders.near(p.x, p.z, 0.4).filter((o) => !o.gone).map((o) => ({ tag: o.tag, lvl: o.lvl, cx: o.cx != null ? +F.l(o.cx, o.cz).x.toFixed(2) : null, cz: o.cx != null ? +F.l(o.cx, o.cz).z.toFixed(2) : null, hx: o.hx && +o.hx.toFixed(2), hz: o.hz && +o.hz.toFixed(2), r: o.r })) }); })()
